en: Sepia-toned street scene showing early 20th‑century urban buildings. At left are multi‑storey residential houses; in the center a straight street recedes into the distance lined with detached houses. Several children and adults walk along the wide road. On the right is a prominent corner building with arched windows and signage for a pharmacy. Handwritten-style text at the top names the location, and the pharmacy sign on the right façade reads "ANKER-APOTHEKE" next to an anchor symbol.
